speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice.

The clinical picture of a well-appearing, exclusively breastfed 2-week-old with a significant indirect bilirubin elevation (16.1 mg/dL) and normal direct bilirubin, in the absence of meconium delay or signs of sepsis, is classic for this condition. No further tests are required.
